name: com.penetrationtestservices/site
title: Penetration Test Services (read-only)
description: Read-only MCP server for penetrationtestservices.com: search and read the site, and find how to contact Excession Labs. No authentication.

tools.name: search_site
tools.title: Search penetrationtestservices.com
tools.description: Search the guides, service pages and research on penetrationtestservices.com. Returns titles, URLs and one-line summaries.

tools.name: get_page
tools.title: Read a page as Markdown
tools.description: Return the Markdown text of a page on penetrationtestservices.com, given its path (for example /guides/).

tools.name: how_to_contact
tools.title: How to contact Excession Labs
tools.description: Return the form URL and email address a person can use to contact Excession Labs. This tool does not send anything.

tools.name: request_pentest
tools.title: Request a security test from Excession Labs
tools.description: Send a request for a penetration test or an AI application security assessment to Excession Labs on behalf of a person who asked for it. Needs an agent key (POST /agent/auth, then Authorization: Bearer <key>). Excession Labs replies to the person by email to agree scope; testing starts only after a written scope and written authorization from the system owner. Never include passwords, API keys or customer data. Limits: 5 requests a day per key, 3 a day per email address.

tools.name: check_security_headers
tools.title: Check a website's security headers
tools.description: Fetch one public web page (one GET per redirect, like a browser visit) and grade its HTTP security headers: HTTPS, HSTS, Content-Security-Policy, clickjacking protection, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, COOP, version disclosure and cookie flags. Reads headers only. This is not a penetration test.
